correctness.rationale: PASS: Structural induction on intuitionistic formulas uses the root implication clause plus classical evaluation at each maximal leaf; formulas depend only on (a,S). Atoms distinguish root colors, while negated classical minterms beta_t at the root distinguish presence/absence of each leaf color, proving injectivity. Each allowed pair is realized by repeat colors to fill k leaves, giving the binomial census. Theta_{n,k}, a finite disjunction of negations of minterms outside k-element sets, holds at all points of F_k but fails at a root with k+1 distinct leaf colors; duplication handles l>k. Independent enumeration of all persistent valuations for 1<=n,k<=3 exactly matched nine formula-count cases: n=2 gives 9,17,21 and n=3 gives 27,76,144. Infinite assertion rests on proof, not bounded enumeration.
